facts.fact: 叙述者 Finn 是一条狗，主人叫 Kari；它通过「后果」学会了家里的规矩。
facts.anchor: He learned that himself through what his owner, Kari, liked to call consequences.

facts.fact: Kari 的邮递员男友在 Finn 眼里叫「pouch」（邮差包），因为男友管它叫 pooch。
facts.anchor: Finn just thought of him as pouch.

facts.fact: Finn 无论怎么跳、怎么警告叫，Kari 都没发现 pouch 趁她不在时踢它、还偷翻她的包。
facts.anchor: Kari never quite caught on that pouch kicked him when she wasn’t looking.

facts.fact: 前一晚 pouch 对 Kari 施暴，撞击拖车裙边的「砰砰」声像啄木鸟一样急促。
facts.anchor: Woodpecker-swift, the Bang bang! Bang bang! echoed when something struck the trailer skirting.

facts.fact: Finn 挣脱出去，带着满速的爱扑向目标——它咬了 pouch。
facts.anchor: He had already launched his own rhyme. A full-throttle love that carried him—feet and fang—straight toward the bullseye.

facts.fact: 结尾 Finn 等待着 Kari 那确定的声音——却始终没有传来。
facts.anchor: He waited now for the certainty of her voice.
